FIELDS.NAME: Sweet Haven Confectionery
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sweet Haven Confectionery, we specialize in retailing a wide array of candies and confections sourced from licensed and inspected manufacturers. Our operations are focused on providing a delightful shopping experience in a clean, secure environment, ensuring compliance with all local health department regulations and inspections. We do not engage in any on-site deep frying or high-heat cooking processes, thereby reducing fire and burn risks. Our store features visually appealing displays of our products, including bulk self-serve bins that are maintained under strict sanitation controls with regular cleaning schedules. Customer safety is our priority, which is emphasized through clear allergen labeling and food safety information displayed prominently on our products. Our team is well-trained in food handling practices, and we maintain current health permits and food handling certifications for all staff. With no sales of alcoholic or cannabis-infused products, we focus solely on offering our extensive range of sweets while adhering to all applicable regulations.

Our candy and confectionery store specializes in producing a variety of gourmet treats, including deep-fried confections such as funnel cakes and candy-coated doughnuts, which make up a significant portion of our offerings.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sweet Haven Confectionery does not own or operate any other businesses that involve significant cooking or high-heat processes.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses to report. Operations comply with fire safety regulations, with no issues related to high-heat cooking processes.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Tamper-resistant, fire-rated safe, Class B, UL-listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Tamper-resistant fencing around the store premises, with regular security patrols during non-business hours.
